findings.summary: The free-shipping check compares subtotal in cents against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD, which is in whole dollars (50), so the effective threshold is 50 cents and nearly all carts get free shipping.

judge.reason: Identifies the cents vs whole-dollar threshold mismatch causing near-universal free shipping.

findings.label: hit
